threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still say 'please' when asking for a coffee, and look shocked when they hand you a flat white without asking if you want it extra hot.
Caught a late 59 last weekend, and the guy in front was singing 'Wonderwall' to the driver. Never thought I'd see bus karaoke in Brixton at 2 AM.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Last week, I spotted a pop-up gallery in a former kebab shop. Only in Neukölln can you find art next to shawarma.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find a cafe that serves chocolate-covered pickles. It's bizarre and oddly delightful, a testament to Berlin's quirky food scene.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know to carry a light jacket even in the summer—San Francisco’s weather is an opportunistic trickster.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy playing a sax on the 6 bus, got off and followed it with a dance down the aisle. Only in SF do we turn commutes into performances.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think late-night bars are buzzing, but the real vibe is in the quiet plazas where locals sip vermut well into the night.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still clutching the map app, zigzagging along streets like it’s a maze. Locals just know to look for the best paella spots.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think it's normal for your mates to suggest brunch places but leave you hanging about who's footing the bill.
Caught the 36 last night; the driver was humming along to reggae while a group of teens practiced their dance moves in the aisle. Classic Peckham vibe.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I found a 24-hour Döner stand where the guy remembers my order and asks how my day was. That’s when I felt at home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you see a street party popping up on a random Tuesday for no reason, complete with techno and kids on scooters. It’s just a vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they argue about the best taco truck at 2 AM and actually care about which salsa is served.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a glimpse of a guy in a three-piece suit doing the cha-cha down the aisle on the 6. Only in San Francisco do you get a dance party on the way to work.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think La Rambla is the heart of the city. But the real vibe is in Gràcia's plazas, where locals sip vermut and chat for hours.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by the way they avoid eye contact on the metro; seasoned locals know the unspoken rule is to nod at least once.
